title: Hook the evening mood into the app
author: claude
summary: The lab's Evening button now shows the evening room.
what: We made the lab's Evening button show the evening room.
why: The baked evening files are only useful if the lab can show them.
how:
- Each mood now has its own light-brightness setting. Evening uses a room exposure of 1.1 and a table reflection strength of 1.65.
- The room's light-map strength is worked out from that setting.
- The sliders reset when you switch moods.
wrong: A small bug: the code that updates the room's light maps did not watch the new setting, so switching mood would not have updated them.
fix: The new setting (`lightScale`) was added to what that code watches.
